sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces maintain pressure through infrastructure strikes and frontline advances, while Ukrainian drone campaigns target economic and military assets. The conflict remains volatile with no immediate resolution in sight.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian authorities report $2.5B potential export losses from port disruptions, while Russian forces continue strikes on logistics hubs. International actors remain divided on escalation management.
sections.intelligence_notes: Persistent drone threats limit frontline advances, while economic warfare through infrastructure strikes creates long-term vulnerabilities. Russian military buildup near the border suggests sustained offensive capacity.
